title: Reviewed annual Ember reporting areas to GeoNames reference context
assumptions: Research acceptance only; use the enumerated tuples at pinned revisions. Preserve raw source identity and NULL, empty, unmatched and ambiguous rows. Fail closed on duplicate targets or changed tuples; no fuzzy match, current-ISO certification, sovereignty or territorial-boundary equivalence is implied. Refresh requires review. Canonical publication, source rights and DataTug execution remain separately gated; B1 stays open at phases 4/5/6.
transformation: Filter Area type == "Country or economy" AND ISO 3 code is nonempty. Use only 209 reviewed tuples in f3r-decisions.json.ember.accepted_tuples. DISTINCT (Area, ISO 3 code, Area type) forms the area projection; exact tuple/code lookup to GeoNames, never fact deduplication. Preserve Year and Electricity source on facts.
reason: Accepted annual source-area context after full label/code review. XKX remains a provider extension, not an official ISO certificate. Fifteen Region areas are excluded with their raw rows retained. Historical observation geography follows Ember methodology, not a timeless GeoNames boundary. No monthly acceptance follows.
